analysis.title: Americas Construction: Building Products: September Import Update
key_insights: Value-weighted unit imports across building product categories fell 12% YOY in September, the 14th consecutive monthly decline, vs -9% in August and -12% a year ago.
Plywood (-29%) and vinyl tiles (-27%) led the decline. Nonwoven glass (+17%) and stoves (+6%) partly offset it.
GS attributes the moderation to the macro and housing backdrop: mortgage rates rose to the 7% range, pressuring big-ticket discretionary projects and related spend, with shifting comps.
GS expects volumes to remain volatile as trade actions, including Section 301 and Section 232 tariffs, plus rising inflation and economic uncertainty weigh on supply and demand.
Global import volumes were still 15% above the same period in 2019 despite the September pressure.
Value-weighted volumes from China fell 15% YOY in September vs -28% in August and -53% a year ago. 9 of 19 categories grew, vs 5 a year ago.

Rest of World (ex-China) imports fell 12% vs -7% in August and -4% last year. Indonesia, Mexico, South Korea and Vietnam led the decline. Cambodia, Czech Republic, Gabon, Spain and Russia posted gains.
China lost about 38bps of value-weighted share YOY.

Wood products: framing lumber, OSB and plywood imports fell 1%, 13% and 29% YOY. Plywood was down 30% sequentially (Indonesia, Canada, Brazil), OSB down 13% sequentially (Canada), framing lumber down 4% sequentially (Canada, Europe).

T-6 appliances: global imports fell 12% YOY (vs -17% in August and last year). LTM volumes are down 23%, led by washers (-41%) and dishwashers (-40%). Imports from China (18% of 2025 imports) fell 19%, with dryers -85% and washers -39%.

Washers: global imports -9% YOY (vs -17% in August). From China -39% YOY. Global volumes are up 164% vs September 2019, and imports remain well below 2018 levels when safeguard measures were implemented.
Dryers: global imports fell 22% YOY (vs -36% in August). Versus September 2019, global imports are +7% and imports from China -74%.
Water heaters: electric tank +2% YOY, gas tank +8%, electric tankless -40% (China, 65% of 2025 imports, -45%), gas tankless -20%.
Cabinets: global imports -17% YOY (vs -29% in August). Imports from China rose 76% YOY vs -75% last month. Global volumes are 26% above September 2019.

Flooring imports fell 16% YOY (vs -8% in August). Vinyl tile imports fell 27% YOY. Mainland China vinyl tile LTM units are down 78% and are 91% below September 2019. Ceramic tile imports fell 9% and carpet imports rose 1%.
Lighting: LTM global imports fell 13% YOY. Mainland China (41% of 2025 volumes) fell 18% YOY in September and its LTM units are down 50%.
Mattress imports fell 16% YOY in September, with LTM down 36%. Nonwoven glass imports rose 17% YOY.

sector_views.rationale: Import volumes are declining in line with weak housing activity and 7% mortgage rates. Tariffs, inflation and uncertainty are expected to keep volumes volatile.
